Companion repository to the official [**Realme Narzo 30A #keepQASSA ROM Port**](https://github.com/omi4real/Realme-Narzo-30A-RMX3171-keepQASSA-Unofficial). --- > [!IMPORTANT] > **Compatibility & Target Platform:** These modules are engineered and hardware-tested specifically for the **Realme Narzo 30A (`RMX3171`)** powered by the **MediaTek Helio G85 (`MT6769Z`)** running **[#keepQASSA Android 10](https://github.com/omi4real/Realme-Narzo-30A-RMX3171-keepQASSA-Unofficial)**. Flashing on other devices or unsupported ROMs is neither tested nor supported. --- ## 📦 Modules Overview | Module Deliverable | Target Subsystems | Key Capabilities | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **[🔊 1. Ultimate Audio Boost](#1-ultimate-audio-boost-v20)** | MediaTek MT6358 Codec & SIA8101 Amp | +15 dB analog line-out uncap, +6 dB earpiece boost, ringtone-grade DRC makeup gain, WideSound filter expansion, persistent ALSA mixer register lock. | | **[⚡ 2. System & UI Enhancements](#2-system--ui-enhancements-v30)** | Framework, Settings, Launcher, Touch | Multi Audio Focus concurrent playback in Settings, responsive fast-motion launcher tap-drop fix, 180Hz gaming touch sampling rate, Schedutil/GED engine. | | **[🚀 3. Performance Engine](#3-performance-engine-v10)** | CPU Governor, GPU GED, Storage, RAM, Touch | Standalone kernel performance suite: 500μs Schedutil latency, MediaTek GED GPU boost, eMMC 5.1 deadline I/O, ZRAM swappiness=80, and 180Hz touch polling. | --- ## 🔬 Technical Architecture & Deep Dive ### 1. Ultimate Audio Boost (v2.0) * **Directory:** `audio_boost/` * **Deliverable:** `N30A_AudioBoost_Magisk.zip` * **Hardware Target:** MediaTek MT6769Z (Helio G85), MT6358 PMIC Codec, and SI-INTECH SIA8101 Class-D Speaker Amplifier. #### Architectural Bottlenecks Solved Stock Realme UI 1.0 clamped audio volume through multiple redundant software and hardware bottlenecks: 1. **Analog Codec Attenuation (`PlaybackVolAna_AudioParam.xml`):** Stock set `speaker_pga = 15` (-7 dB attenuation). Baseline vendor set `7` (+1 dB). 2. **Volume Curve Clamping (`VolumeGainMap_AudioParam.xml`):** `param_id="3"` (`SPK_LO`) hard-coded `dl_total_gain` and `dl_analog_gain` to `-1 dB` maximum across all 40 volume steps, overriding higher user settings. 3. **Music DRC Bypass (`PlaybackDRC_AudioParam.xml`):** Ringtones received full dynamic range compression (`DRC_Gn = 6144`), while music playback had zero dynamic makeup gain (`DRC_Gn = 0`), making media volume sound muffled compared to ringtones. 4. **Hardware Notch Filtering (`PlaybackACF_AudioParam.xml`):** An aggressive notch filter (`bes_loudness_L_bpf_gain = -1023`) heavily attenuated 300 Hz vocal frequencies, while WideSound gain was disabled (`WS_Gain_Max = 0x0`). 5. **Runtime Gain Reset:** During Android initialization, `AudioMTKGainController::setVoiceVolume` reset ALSA line-out gain registers to index `11` (-3 dB). #### The 5-Pillar Calibration * **Analog Line-Out Boost (+8 dB MAX):** Uncaps `speaker_pga` to index `0` (+8 dB analog headroom, a **+15 dB increase** over stock OEM). * **In-Call Earpiece Boost (+6 dB):** Sets `receiver_pga` to index `2` for crystal-clear call audio. * **VolumeGainMap Uncap:** Unlocks positive analog and total gain curves up to +8 dB in `SPK_LO`. * **Digital Dynamic Range (+8 dB):** Unlocks positive digital gain steps up to +8 dB in `PlaybackVolDigi`. * **Ringtone-Grade DRC Makeup:** Injects 6144 makeup gain and Sub-Band expansion into music playback. * **Acoustic Filter Relaxation:** Removes the -1023 notch filter and enables `bes_loudness_WS_Gain_Max = 0x8` (+8 dB WideSound). * **Late-Start Mixer Lock Daemon:** Bundles a static `tinymix` binary in `service.sh` that explicitly locks ALSA hardware registers (`Lineout_PGAL_GAIN = 0`, `ADDA_DL_GAIN = 65535`) after Android boot to prevent framework overrides. --- ### 2. System & UI Enhancements (v3.0) * **Directory:** `system_enhancements/` * **Deliverable:** `N30A_System_Enhancements_Magisk.zip` * **Subsystems Patched:** `services.jar`, `Settings.apk`, `Launcher3QuickStep.apk`, `RealmeParts.apk`, Kernel sysfs. #### Key Enhancements * **🎵 Multi Audio Focus Framework (`services.jar`):** - Smali hook inside `com.android.server.audio.MediaFocusControl` skips `propagateFocusLossFromGain_syncAf` when `multi_audio_focus_enabled=1`. - Enables **simultaneous audio playback** across apps (e.g. YouTube app and Brave Browser playing together, podcast while navigating, or gaming with background music). - Priority protection preserved: incoming phone calls and alarms (`enteringRingOrCall`) immediately preempt background audio. * **⚙️ KeepQassa Miscellaneous Toggle (`Settings.apk`):** - Injected `SystemSettingSwitchPreference` (`multi_audio_focus_enabled`) in `#keepQASSA -> Miscellaneous` directly below *"Show app volume"*. - Instant on-the-fly toggling between multi-audio and stock Android audio arbitration. * **⚡ Responsive Fast-Motion Launcher (`Launcher3QuickStep.apk`):** - Bypasses `isFinishedSwitchingState()` in `ItemClickHandler.smali` to eliminate dropped/ignored app taps during homescreen transition animations. - Whitelists `android.permission.STOP_APP_SWITCHES` for instant zero-latency app launches. * **🖐️ 180Hz Touch Sampling Suite (`RealmeParts.apk`):** - Provides a clean *"Smooth scrolling"* switch under `Realme Parts -> Display`. - Toggles `/proc/touchpanel/game_switch_enable` (180Hz high-frequency touch polling) and disables Oppo kernel touch throttling limits (`/proc/touchpanel/oppo_tp_limit_enable = 0`). * **🚀 Kernel & Memory Performance Engine (`service.sh`):** - **Schedutil Frequency Latency:** Ramp-up latency lowered to `500μs` (instant core spin-up) and down-rate smoothed to `20000μs`. - **MediaTek GED GPU Governor:** Enables dynamic GPU boost on high-demand frame rendering. - **eMMC I/O Optimization:** Deadline scheduler with 512KB readahead for fast app startup. - **RAM Optimization:** `vm.swappiness = 80` for balanced ZRAM memory caching. --- ### 3. Performance Engine (v1.0) * **Directory:** `performance_engine/` * **Deliverable:** `N30A_Performance_Engine_Magisk.zip` * **Size:** Ultra-lightweight (~5 KB) * **Target:** MediaTek Helio G85 (`MT6769Z`) Kernel, GED GPU Daemon, eMMC Storage, ZRAM, and Realme Touchpanel. #### Optimization Architecture Built specifically for users on **keepQASSA v2.5.s** (or those who already have UI components baked into `/system`) who want a pure, non-intrusive kernel optimization daemon without replacing any system APKs or clearing ART dalvik-cache: * **⚡ CPU Schedutil Latency (500μs ramp):** Lowers schedutil `up_rate_limit_us` from 10,000μs to **500μs**, achieving instant 0.5ms frequency response during UI interactions and eliminating frame stutters. * **🎮 MediaTek GED GPU Smart Boost:** Forces `ged_smart_boost=1`, `boost_gpu_enable=1`, and `enable_gpu_boost=1`, locking the Mali-G52 MC2 to its peak 823 MHz clock during graphics workloads. * **💾 eMMC 5.1 Storage I/O Optimization:** Switches queue scheduler to `deadline` and sets `read_ahead_kb = 512` for accelerated sequential app launch and asset streaming. * **🧠 ZRAM Thrashing Reduction:** Tunes `vm.swappiness = 80` and `vfs_cache_pressure = 50` with balanced dirty writeback ratios to eliminate background app killing. * **🖐️ 180Hz Gaming Touch Polling Engine:** Activates `/proc/touchpanel/game_switch_enable = 1` and disables OEM drag suppression (`oppo_tp_limit_enable = 0`) at boot. * **🔋 MediaTek PPM Ultra-Low Power Sleep Policy:** Enforces policy `9 1` during display-off states for exceptional battery life on the 6,000 mAh cell. --- ## 📟 Terminal Flashing Preview Both modules feature a clean, minimal ASCII art banner designed strictly under 38 columns to render without line-wrapping on any mobile terminal: ```text _ _ _____ ___ _ | \ | |___ // _ \ / \ | \| | |_ \ | | |/ _ \ | |\ |___) | |_| / ___ \ |_| \_|____/\___//_/ \_\ ================================== Realme Narzo 30A (RMX3171) Created by @omi4real ================================== -> N30A System & UI Enhancements ---------------------------------- - Staging Multi Audio Focus (services.jar) - Staging KeepQassa Misc Toggle (Settings.apk) - Staging Responsive Launcher (Launcher3QuickStep.apk) - Staging 180Hz Touch Suite (RealmeParts.apk) - Applying kernel & schedutil governor engine - Clearing stale ART runtime caches... ---------------------------------- - Done! Reboot to activate all enhancements. ``` --- ## 📥 Downloads & Verified Checksums | Module ZIP Package | File Size | MD5 Checksum | SHA-256 Checksum | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **`N30A_AudioBoost_Magisk.zip`** | ~299 KB | `ca42cfa46518f99a12c3e31ef734c0fc` | `03ba5ee230e851caacae0f8b53b38f1f37adcd6a2261f09c79813e8a214b4c37` | | **`N30A_Performance_Engine_Magisk.zip`** | ~5 KB | `bd7042a64f885976ea533f323c0c1b90` | `bea646c74560fd28c77d812cf2b71762d1b33d8b82f713712b03f00f28dad43e` | | **`N30A_System_Enhancements_Magisk.zip`** | ~38 MB | `4e7814dd9cce99a49511a7d159260556` | `011f3a87dff05bda98266235e2409b28fbfbbf6b0302f849472f02d9f8584ae0` | --- ## 📲 Installation Instructions > [!NOTE] > **Flashing Method:** Installation is exclusively recommended and tested via the **Magisk App**. Flashing root modules through custom recovery (TWRP / OrangeFox) is not recommended and unsupported. 1. Download the desired module `.zip` from [**Releases**](https://github.com/omi4real/Realme-Narzo-30A-Magisk-Addons/releases) to your internal device storage. 2. Open the **Magisk App** and navigate to the **Modules** tab. 3. Tap **Install from storage** and select the `.zip` file. 4. Verify the terminal flashing output and wait for the installer to finish. 5. A curated suite of hardware-calibrated root modules built and tuned specifically for the Realme Narzo 30A (RMX3171) running Android 10 (#keepQASSA).

Companion repository to the official Realme Narzo 30A #keepQASSA ROM Port.

Downloads • Modules Overview • Technical Architecture • Flashing Instructions • Terminal Preview • Credits

---

> [!IMPORTANT]

> Compatibility & Target Platform: These modules are engineered and hardware-tested specifically for the Realme Narzo 30A (RMX3171) powered by the MediaTek Helio G85 (MT6769Z) running #keepQASSA Android 10. Flashing on other devices or unsupported ROMs is neither tested nor supported.

---

📦 Modules Overview

| Module Deliverable | Target Subsystems | Key Capabilities |

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| 🔊 1. Ultimate Audio Boost | MediaTek MT6358 Codec & SIA8101 Amp | +15 dB analog line-out uncap, +6 dB earpiece boost, ringtone-grade DRC makeup gain, WideSound filter expansion, persistent ALSA mixer register lock. |

| ⚡ 2. System & UI Enhancements | Framework, Settings, Launcher, Touch | Multi Audio Focus concurrent playback in Settings, responsive fast-motion launcher tap-drop fix, 180Hz gaming touch sampling rate, Schedutil/GED engine. |

| 🚀 3. Performance Engine | CPU Governor, GPU GED, Storage, RAM, Touch | Standalone kernel performance suite: 500μs Schedutil latency, MediaTek GED GPU boost, eMMC 5.1 deadline I/O, ZRAM swappiness=80, and 180Hz touch polling. |

---

🔬 Technical Architecture & Deep Dive

1. Ultimate Audio Boost (v2.0)

  • **Directory:** `audio_boost/`
  • **Deliverable:** `N30A_AudioBoost_Magisk.zip`
  • **Hardware Target:** MediaTek MT6769Z (Helio G85), MT6358 PMIC Codec, and SI-INTECH SIA8101 Class-D Speaker Amplifier.

    • #### Architectural Bottlenecks Solved

    Stock Realme UI 1.0 clamped audio volume through multiple redundant software and hardware bottlenecks:

  • **Analog Codec Attenuation (`PlaybackVolAna_AudioParam.xml`):** Stock set `speaker_pga = 15` (-7 dB attenuation). Baseline vendor set `7` (+1 dB).
  • **Volume Curve Clamping (`VolumeGainMap_AudioParam.xml`):** `param_id="3"` (`SPK_LO`) hard-coded `dl_total_gain` and `dl_analog_gain` to `-1 dB` maximum across all 40 volume steps, overriding higher user settings.
  • **Music DRC Bypass (`PlaybackDRC_AudioParam.xml`):** Ringtones received full dynamic range compression (`DRC_Gn = 6144`), while music playback had zero dynamic makeup gain (`DRC_Gn = 0`), making media volume sound muffled compared to ringtones.
  • **Hardware Notch Filtering (`PlaybackACF_AudioParam.xml`):** An aggressive notch filter (`bes_loudness_L_bpf_gain = -1023`) heavily attenuated 300 Hz vocal frequencies, while WideSound gain was disabled (`WS_Gain_Max = 0x0`).
  • **Runtime Gain Reset:** During Android initialization, `AudioMTKGainController::setVoiceVolume` reset ALSA line-out gain registers to index `11` (-3 dB).

    • #### The 5-Pillar Calibration

  • **Analog Line-Out Boost (+8 dB MAX):** Uncaps `speaker_pga` to index `0` (+8 dB analog headroom, a **+15 dB increase** over stock OEM).
  • **In-Call Earpiece Boost (+6 dB):** Sets `receiver_pga` to index `2` for crystal-clear call audio.
  • **VolumeGainMap Uncap:** Unlocks positive analog and total gain curves up to +8 dB in `SPK_LO`.
  • **Digital Dynamic Range (+8 dB):** Unlocks positive digital gain steps up to +8 dB in `PlaybackVolDigi`.
  • **Ringtone-Grade DRC Makeup:** Injects 6144 makeup gain and Sub-Band expansion into music playback.
  • **Acoustic Filter Relaxation:** Removes the -1023 notch filter and enables `bes_loudness_WS_Gain_Max = 0x8` (+8 dB WideSound).
  • **Late-Start Mixer Lock Daemon:** Bundles a static `tinymix` binary in `service.sh` that explicitly locks ALSA hardware registers (`Lineout_PGAL_GAIN = 0`, `ADDA_DL_GAIN = 65535`) after Android boot to prevent framework overrides.

    • ---

    2. System & UI Enhancements (v3.0)

  • **Directory:** `system_enhancements/`
  • **Deliverable:** `N30A_System_Enhancements_Magisk.zip`
  • **Subsystems Patched:** `services.jar`, `Settings.apk`, `Launcher3QuickStep.apk`, `RealmeParts.apk`, Kernel sysfs.

    • #### Key Enhancements

  • **🎵 Multi Audio Focus Framework (`services.jar`):**

    • - Smali hook inside com.android.server.audio.MediaFocusControl skips propagateFocusLossFromGain_syncAf when multi_audio_focus_enabled=1.

    - Enables simultaneous audio playback across apps (e.g. YouTube app and Brave Browser playing together, podcast while navigating, or gaming with background music).

    - Priority protection preserved: incoming phone calls and alarms (enteringRingOrCall) immediately preempt background audio.

  • **⚙️ KeepQassa Miscellaneous Toggle (`Settings.apk`):**

    • - Injected SystemSettingSwitchPreference (multi_audio_focus_enabled) in #keepQASSA -> Miscellaneous directly below *"Show app volume"*.

    - Instant on-the-fly toggling between multi-audio and stock Android audio arbitration.

  • **⚡ Responsive Fast-Motion Launcher (`Launcher3QuickStep.apk`):**

    • - Bypasses isFinishedSwitchingState() in ItemClickHandler.smali to eliminate dropped/ignored app taps during homescreen transition animations.

    - Whitelists android.permission.STOP_APP_SWITCHES for instant zero-latency app launches.

  • **🖐️ 180Hz Touch Sampling Suite (`RealmeParts.apk`):**

    • - Provides a clean *"Smooth scrolling"* switch under Realme Parts -> Display.

    - Toggles /proc/touchpanel/game_switch_enable (180Hz high-frequency touch polling) and disables Oppo kernel touch throttling limits (/proc/touchpanel/oppo_tp_limit_enable = 0).

  • **🚀 Kernel & Memory Performance Engine (`service.sh`):**

    • - Schedutil Frequency Latency: Ramp-up latency lowered to 500μs (instant core spin-up) and down-rate smoothed to 20000μs.

    - MediaTek GED GPU Governor: Enables dynamic GPU boost on high-demand frame rendering.

    - eMMC I/O Optimization: Deadline scheduler with 512KB readahead for fast app startup.

    - RAM Optimization: vm.swappiness = 80 for balanced ZRAM memory caching.

    ---

    3. Performance Engine (v1.0)

  • **Directory:** `performance_engine/`
  • **Deliverable:** `N30A_Performance_Engine_Magisk.zip`
  • **Size:** Ultra-lightweight (~5 KB)
  • **Target:** MediaTek Helio G85 (`MT6769Z`) Kernel, GED GPU Daemon, eMMC Storage, ZRAM, and Realme Touchpanel.

    • #### Optimization Architecture

    Built specifically for users on keepQASSA v2.5.s (or those who already have UI components baked into /system) who want a pure, non-intrusive kernel optimization daemon without replacing any system APKs or clearing ART dalvik-cache:

  • **⚡ CPU Schedutil Latency (500μs ramp):** Lowers schedutil `up_rate_limit_us` from 10,000μs to **500μs**, achieving instant 0.5ms frequency response during UI interactions and eliminating frame stutters.
  • **🎮 MediaTek GED GPU Smart Boost:** Forces `ged_smart_boost=1`, `boost_gpu_enable=1`, and `enable_gpu_boost=1`, locking the Mali-G52 MC2 to its peak 823 MHz clock during graphics workloads.
  • **💾 eMMC 5.1 Storage I/O Optimization:** Switches queue scheduler to `deadline` and sets `read_ahead_kb = 512` for accelerated sequential app launch and asset streaming.
  • **🧠 ZRAM Thrashing Reduction:** Tunes `vm.swappiness = 80` and `vfs_cache_pressure = 50` with balanced dirty writeback ratios to eliminate background app killing.
  • **🖐️ 180Hz Gaming Touch Polling Engine:** Activates `/proc/touchpanel/game_switch_enable = 1` and disables OEM drag suppression (`oppo_tp_limit_enable = 0`) at boot.
  • **🔋 MediaTek PPM Ultra-Low Power Sleep Policy:** Enforces policy `9 1` during display-off states for exceptional battery life on the 6,000 mAh cell.

    • ---

    📲 Installation Instructions

    > [!NOTE]

    > Flashing Method: Installation is exclusively recommended and tested via the Magisk App. Flashing root modules through custom recovery (TWRP / OrangeFox) is not recommended and unsupported.

  • Download the desired module `.zip` from [**Releases**](https://github.com/omi4real/Realme-Narzo-30A-Magisk-Addons/releases) to your internal device storage.
  • Open the **Magisk App** and navigate to the **Modules** tab.
  • Tap **Install from storage** and select the `.zip` file.
  • Verify the terminal flashing output and wait for the installer to finish.
  • Tap **Reboot**.
